BEFORE YOU VISIT

A few things
you might ask.

Can we visit just for food and drinks?

Yes. Food and drinks are part of the Joy Ripples experience. Contact Isaac or Joyce to discuss your visit and confirm availability.

Can you cater at our own venue?

Joy Ripples offers outside catering. Share your date, guest count, location and food preferences so the team can discuss your requirements.

How do I book a stay or event?

Use the enquiry form to prepare a WhatsApp message, or call the team directly. Room availability, event arrangements and rates are confirmed by the resort.

Do you host team building groups?

Yes. Tell the team your preferred date, group size and what you have in mind. They can help you discuss a suitable plan.
